name: AgentFrameworkWorkshop
postCreateCommand: python3 -m venv /home/vscode/.venv && /home/vscode/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && /home/vscode/.venv/bin/python -m pip install pypdf pdfplumber && mkdir -p /home/vscode/.config/powershell && grep -qxF 'export PATH="/home/vscode/.venv/bin:$PATH"' /home/vscode/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="/home/vscode/.venv/bin:$PATH"' >> /home/vscode/.bashrc && grep -qxF '$env:Path = "/home/vscode/.venv/bin" + [IO.Path]::PathSeparator + $env:Path' /home/vscode/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 2>/dev/null || echo '$env:Path = "/home/vscode/.venv/bin" + [IO.Path]::PathSeparator + $env:Path' >> /home/vscode/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1
postStartCommand: dotnet dev-certs https --trust || true; grep -q 'SSL_CERT_DIR' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export SSL_CERT_DIR="$HOME/.aspnet/dev-certs/trust:/usr/lib/ssl/certs"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
